module_summary: Synchronous FIFO with dual-port handshakes; push on write side when ready, pop on read side when valid.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: Stores FIFO data elements; read/written at wptr/rptr indices.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer; increments on push to index mem_q.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer; increments on pop to index mem_q.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count; drives in_ready and out_valid for handshakes.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid signal; paired with in_ready for push handshake.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready signal; asserted when not full.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid signal; paired with out_ready for pop handshake.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Read-side ready signal; enables pop when asserted.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write-side data payload; stored in mem_q on push.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Read-side data payload; output from mem_q via rptr.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush control; resets pointers and count to empty state.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Push gating signal; enables mem_q write and wptr increment.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Pop gating signal; enables rptr increment and count decrement.

anchors.name: count_o
anchors.why: Occupancy output; mirrors count_q for external monitoring.

groups.name: FIFO Memory
groups.description: Circular buffer array storing data elements indexed by read/write pointers.

groups.name: Write Handshake
groups.description: Write-side VALID/READY protocol and data payload.

groups.name: Read Handshake
groups.description: Read-side VALID/READY protocol and data payload.

groups.name: Control Logic
groups.description: Pointers, occupancy counter, and push/pop gating; flush control.
